mf_base_url.label: Base URL / IP Address
mf_base_url.description: The address of your MusicFree server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10

mf_port.label: Port
mf_port.description: The port your MusicFree server listens on (leave empty for the default)

mf_path.label: Server Path
mf_path.description: Optional sub path under which the server is served (e.g. /subsonic), usually left empty

mf_username.label: Username
mf_username.description: Your username for this MusicFree server

mf_password.label: Password
mf_password.description: The password associated with the username

mf_reco_size.label: Recommendation Limit
mf_reco_size.description: How many recommendations from each enabled type should be included.

mf_page_size.label: Number of items included per server request.
mf_page_size.description: When enumerating items from the server, how many should be in each request. Smaller will require more requests but is better for low bandwidth connections.

manifest.description: Stream music from your MusicFree (music-free-site) server.

errors.connect_failed: Failed to connect to {0}, check your settings.
errors.auth_failed: Invalid username or password for the MusicFree server. Check your settings and try again.
